shared_protocol.sampler: reuse B20 physical-window order; clean/background per physical window; no outcome-dependent resampling
shared_protocol.scheduler: MultiStepLR milestones=[600], gamma=0.1, applied after each update; no reduced-LR update before final
shared_protocol.backend: Math SDPA, Flash and memory-efficient disabled
shared_protocol.action_loss: official unweighted mean L1 over all8x7 valid values
shared_protocol.normalization: same20train action/proprio statistics as B20; same AE-C train-only center statistics for C/D targets
shared_protocol.stage: joint action and auxiliary, no additional RLA-only updates
shared_protocol.randomness: same initial CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy state and official stochastic graph for C/D; added RLA draws need not reproduce B20 random consumption after step0
shared_protocol.selection: final600 only, no early stopping or budget extension

preflight: isolated full microbatch8 plus backward; no optimizer update; formal process reloads common RNG
memory_optimization_rule: only if necessary: activation checkpointing or matched microbatch reduction with same16 appearance effective batch; record numeric/RNG deviations
appearance_rules: same B20 order; each physical window clean then background; no extra augmentation
invalid_rule: task failure valid; infrastructure failure retained and experiment stops for diagnosis; no silent retry
